fusions.name: Gnawing Swipe
fusions.desc: A quick bite that deals 4 damage. It has a 25% chance of [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Vermin Stampede
fusions.desc: Tramples every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 28 damage. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. The blow ignores armour.

fusions.name: Scrabble Free
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Warren Mate
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded familiar that fights beside you, striking for 3 damage.
